description.zh: 短版命名空间ID，不需要带上region，推荐。
description.en: The short-format namespace ID. You do not need to include the region ID. We recommend that you use this parameter.

description.zh: 长版命名空间ID。如果设置了该参数会继续生效而忽略NameSpaceShortId，该参数是为了兼容保留，推荐使用短版命名空间ID，简化参数。
description.en: The long-format namespace ID. If you set this parameter, it takes precedence over NameSpaceShortId. This parameter is for backward compatibility. Use the short-format namespace ID to simplify the request.

description.zh: VPC ID。用于替换现有的VPC ID。
description.en: The ID of the VPC. This VPC replaces the original VPC.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sae update-namespace-vpc --namespace-id cn-beijing:test --vpc-id vpc-2ze0i263cnn311nvj0000 --name-space-short-id test --region cn-hangzhou
